text: file path generated YAML file (invisibly).

title: Football red cards study methodology text (Group 20) — football_grp20
text: character string describing methodology reported Team 20 many-analysts study racial bias football referee decisions (Silberzahn et al., 2018: <https://osf.io/qix4g/>). text can passed directly [extract_schema()].

title: Football red cards study methodology text (Group 20) — football_grp20
code: football_grp20

title: Football red cards study methodology text (Group 20) — football_grp20
text: character string length 1, combining three phases   analysis: (1) variable creation data cleaning, covering   derivation age birthday, skin-tone rating   rater1 rater2, position recoding via   Wikipedia, grand-mean centering predictors, standardisation   racial bias scores, exclusion players missing   skin-tone data; (2) model specification, describing four-level   multilevel negative-binomial model (dyads > players > clubs >   leagues), dependent variable (redCards), full   predictor set including skin-tone rating, implicit explicit   racial bias, interactions, covariates; (3)   covariate justification, providing theoretical rationale   controlling games, victories, defeats,   goals, height, weight, position,   age.

title: Football red cards study methodology text (Group 20) — football_grp20
text: Silberzahn, R., et al. (2018). Many analysts, one dataset:   Making transparent variations analytical choices affect   results. Advances Methods Practices   Psychological Science, 1(3), 337–356.   doi:10.1177/2515245917747646

what: Generate analytical alternatives via LLM — gen_alternatives
title: Generate analytical alternatives via LLM — gen_alternatives
text: `gen_alternatives()` takes existing `schema` `multiverse` asks Large Language Model suggest methodologically valid, alternative approaches specific step (block) analysis pipeline. `prompt_alternatives()` helper function constructs exact instruction set sent LLM.

title: Generate analytical alternatives via LLM — gen_alternatives
code: gen_alternatives(x, block, n = 3, provider = "gemini", file_path = NULL, ...)  # S3 method for class 'character' gen_alternatives(x, ...)  # S3 method for class 'schema' gen_alternatives(x, block, n = 3, provider = "gemini", file_path = NULL, ...)  # S3 method for class 'multiverse' gen_alternatives(x, block, ...)  prompt_alternatives(block, n = 3, print = FALSE)

title: Generate analytical alternatives via LLM — gen_alternatives
text: x `schema` `multiverse` object, character string specifying file path valid `tines` YAML file. block character string. exact `tag` step/node want LLM generate alternatives . n integer. number distinct alternatives want LLM generate. Defaults `3`. provider character string specifying LLM provider. Currently defaults `"gemini"`. (`gemini-3-flash-preview` via `ellmer`). file_path character string specifying save generated YAML output. `NULL` (default), `capture.output()` return result character vector. ... Additional arguments passed methods `ellmer::chat_google_gemini()`. print logical. `TRUE`, prompt generated `prompt_alternatives()` printed console readable format. Default `FALSE`

title: Generate analytical alternatives via LLM — gen_alternatives
text: * `gen_alternatives()` invisibly returns `NULL` writes output `file_path`. * `prompt_alternatives()` returns formatted character string containing LLM prompt.

title: Generate analytical alternatives via LLM — gen_alternatives
text: **Important:** function relies `ellmer` package communicate Google's Gemini API. must API credentials configured correctly R environment (e.g., via `GEMINI_API_KEY` environment variable) work.

title: Generate analytical alternatives via LLM — gen_alternatives
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ hdi <- example_schema() gen_alternatives(hdi, block = "block-combine", n = 1,                 file_path = here::here("inst/hdi-alt.yaml")) } # }

title: Auto-Fix an R Script via Iterative LLM Debugging — validate_script
text: Executes R script isolated sandbox. execution fails, error passed LLM (currently Google Gemini) attempts fix script. loop repeats max_runs times.

title: Auto-Fix an R Script via Iterative LLM Debugging — validate_script
code: validate_script(   file,   data = NULL,   max_runs = 5,   model = "gemini-2.5-pro",   verbose = TRUE,   as_job = FALSE,   engine = c("callr", "docker"),   scan_code = TRUE )

title: Auto-Fix an R Script via Iterative LLM Debugging — validate_script
text: file Path R script run debug. data Optional path CSV data file make available inside sandbox data/<basename>. max_runs Maximum number LLM fix attempts. Default 5. model Gemini model string. Default "gemini-2.5-pro". verbose TRUE, saves copy script iteration. as_job TRUE, runs process background job. FALSE (default), runs current R session. used engine = "callr". engine One "callr" (default) "docker". Controls execution callr temp directory sandbox (session background job), within Docker container. scan_code TRUE (default), scans script potentially dangerous file system commands execution.
